title: Armature vocabulary
description: The names Armature's tools share (ADR-0073): terms, reserved words and avoided words. The reasoning behind each is in docs/naming-vocabulary.md, which a check holds to this file.

revision.description: The date of the last change to a name or a status; packages/vocabulary/CHANGES.md lists each. Not a hub's client revision.

terms.description: One entry per shared concept, or per label of one.

reserved.description: Words that hold one meaning without being a term's name. Every term's name is reserved for that term without an entry here.

avoided.description: Words deliberately not used for a concept or an audience, each with the reason.

audiences.description: Who reads the word: people (designers, reviewers, researchers), administrators (and operators), developers (tool authors).

identifiers.description: The codes, routes, fields or enumeration values the word stands for. They never change with the word.

row.description: A row of the working document: its section's number and its Concept cell, without code marks.

in.description: Present when the words are given in the row's Recommended cell and are not one of the row's chosen names: a refusal code's words.

id.description: A stable key, never renamed, so a tool and a translation can key on it.

name.description: The word or label. <parent>, <branch>, <instance> and <n> stand for the name or number a label carries.

status.description: recommended: the working document's proposal. chosen: decided. kept: in use and unchanged, with no decision needed.

until.description: For a name that waits on something not yet built: what it waits on (an ADR's number, or a condition in words) and the name to use until then. Without a name, the concept does not exist until then and nothing is shown.

also.description: Other rows where the working document chooses the same name for the same concept.

for.description: The id of the term the word belongs to.

word.description: The word or phrase avoided, in lower case unless it is written one way only.

forms.description: Its other forms, matched as the word is.

for.description: The id of the term it must not name, or * when it is avoided outright for the audience.

use.description: The id of the term to use instead; absent when the thing needs no name for that audience.

allowed.description: Uses that remain correct, in words.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence, with the evidence's reference from the working document.

row.description: What decided it in the working document: a section, and within it a collision, a principle or a row's Concept cell.
